description: No quota/limit enforcement anywhere. Spec defines limits via capability fields: maxBodyBytes (message body size), maxAttachmentsPerMessage, maxAttachmentBytes (per attachment), maxGroupMembers, maxSpaceMembers, maxRolesPerSpace, maxChannelsPerSpace, maxCategoriesPerSpace. Handlers should check these limits and return overQuota or invalidProperties SetErrors. Also: emoji name must match /^[a-z0-9_-]+$/ (spec line ~691), mention offset+length must not exceed body byte length.
title: Enforce quota and capability limits
